# IRIS Manufacturing Ltd.

> Professional bath bombs factory, beauty gift factory, body care factory, shower gel factory based in Jiangxi, China. Over 15 years of experience in OEM/ODM manufacturing.

## About
IRIS Manufacturing Ltd. is a leading OEM/ODM manufacturer specializing in bath bombs, beauty gift sets, body care products, and shower gel. Located in Nanchang City, Jiangxi Province, China. Our 100,000 sqm facility with 8 workshops and 2 professional assembly lines produces 50,000 tons annually. FDA & EEC certified. Walmart-approved supplier.

## Core Products
- Bath Bombs Factory: Custom bath bombs, fizzers, flower-shaped, heart-shaped, kids bath bombs
- Beauty Gift Factory: Bath & body gift sets, holiday collections, seasonal series
- Body Care Factory: Hand creams, body wash, shower gels, bubble bath products
- Shower Gel Factory: Private label shower gel, body wash OEM/ODM
- Holiday Collecting: Christmas, Valentine's Day, Summer special series

## Services
- OEM Manufacturing: Custom formulations and private label production
- ODM Services: Complete product development from concept to market
- Custom packaging design and branding
- Quality assurance meeting FDA and EEC standards
- Low MOQ: 500 sets for initial orders

## Certifications
- FDA Compliant
- EEC Standards
- ISO Certified
- Walmart Factory Audit Passed

## Production Capacity
- Factory Area: 100,000 sqm
